crossRefs.note: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

translations.web: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”
translations.bsb: “Where are they taking the basket?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
translations.kjv: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
translations.asv: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
